import time
from appium import webdriver
from appium.options.ios import XCUITestOptions

options = XCUITestOptions()
options.udid = "432923F0-8C4D-4767-953B-17201250A83B"
options.bundle_id = "im.vector.app"
options.no_reset = True
options.auto_accept_alerts = True
options.new_command_timeout = 300

driver = webdriver.Remote("http://127.0.0.1:4723", options=options)
try:
    els = driver.find_elements("-ios predicate string", "label == 'Team Standup'")
    print("Team Standup matches:", len(els))
    els[0].click()
    time.sleep(3)
    png = driver.get_screenshot_as_png()
    open("/tmp/room.png", "wb").write(png)
    print("size:", driver.get_window_size())
    print("saved /tmp/room.png")
finally:
    driver.quit()

import time
from appium import webdriver
from appium.options.ios import XCUITestOptions

options = XCUITestOptions()
options.udid = "432923F0-8C4D-4767-953B-17201250A83B"
options.bundle_id = "im.vector.app"
options.no_reset = True
options.auto_accept_alerts = True

    els[0].click()
    time.sleep(3)

        print("tapping thread icon by coordinates")
        driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": 358, "y": 75})
    time.sleep(3)
    png = driver.get_screenshot_as_png()
    open("/tmp/threads.png", "wb").write(png)
    print("saved /tmp/threads.png")
finally:
    driver.quit()

options.udid = "432923F0-8C4D-4767-953B-17201250A83B"
options.bundle_id = "im.vector.app"
options.no_reset = True
options.auto_accept_alerts = True
options.new_command_timeout = 300

driver = webdriver.Remote("http://127.0.0.1:4723", options=options)
try:
    els = driver.find_elements("-ios predicate string", "label == 'Team Standup'")
    print("Team Standup matches:", len(els))
    els[0].click()
    time.sleep(3)

    got = driver.find_elements("-ios predicate string", "label == 'Got it'")
    print("Got it buttons:", len(got))
    if got:
        got[0].click()
        time.sleep(2)

    btns = driver.find_elements("class name", "XCUIElementTypeButton")
    print("total buttons:", len(btns))
    thread_btn = None
    for b in btns:
        f = b.rect
        lbl = b.get_attribute("label")
        name = b.get_attribute("name")
        print(f"label={lbl!r} name={name!r} rect={f}")
        if f["y"] < 120 and (
            (name and "thread" in name.lower())
            or (lbl and "thread" in lbl.lower())
        ):
            thread_btn = b

    if thread_btn:
        print("tapping thread button by element")
        thread_btn.click()
    else:
        print("tapping thread icon by coordinates (358, 75)")
        driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": 358, "y": 75})
    time.sleep(3)

    png = driver.get_screenshot_as_png()
    open("/tmp/threads.png", "wb").write(png)
    texts = driver.find_elements("class name", "XCUIElementTypeStaticText")
    print("static texts:", [t.get_attribute("label") for t in texts[:15]])
    print("saved /tmp/threads.png")
finally:
    driver.quit()
